verdict.rationale: Meltano is a CLI-first tool with a documented, scriptable command-line interface (meltano init, meltano add, meltano config test, meltano run) that requires no GUI, confirmed by a hands-on runtime probe showing keyless CLI execution producing a full project layout. Docs explicitly endorse treating projects like software repos with version control and CI/CD, and containerization/Docker support further enables headless CI use. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party CI pipeline example (e.g. GitHub Actions YAML) or independent report of running Meltano inside a CI system in production.
